"""Hash and diff git blobs for the W2-141 rebase review (read-only; writes only under this folder)."""
import difflib
import hashlib
import os
import subprocess
import sys

REPO = "/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-141-rebase-review"
OUT = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))


def blob(spec):
    return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", REPO, "cat-file", "blob", spec],
                          check=True, capture_output=True).stdout


def disk(path):
    with open(os.path.join(REPO, path), "rb") as f:
        return f.read()


SPECS = {
    "staged_new": ("git", "beec1f2f8:docs/changes/W2-141-hook/pretooluse.py"),
    "staged_new_disk": ("disk", "docs/changes/W2-141-hook/pretooluse.py"),
    "live_at_commit": ("git", "beec1f2f8:.claude/hooks/pretooluse.py"),
    "live_disk": ("disk", ".claude/hooks/pretooluse.py"),
    "live_integrate_head": ("git", "w2/integrate:.claude/hooks/pretooluse.py"),
    "staged_old": ("git", "beec1f2f8~1:docs/changes/W2-141-hook/pretooluse.py"),
    "hook_15952bbfa": ("git", "15952bbfa:.claude/hooks/pretooluse.py"),
    "hook_147706ae4": ("git", "147706ae4:.claude/hooks/pretooluse.py"),
    "hook_b7a373cf9": ("git", "b7a373cf9:.claude/hooks/pretooluse.py"),
    "hook_2a6462653": ("git", "2a6462653:.claude/hooks/pretooluse.py"),
    "hook_9cce7430d": ("git", "9cce7430d:.claude/hooks/pretooluse.py"),
    "hook_4edd196c5": ("git", "4edd196c5:.claude/hooks/pretooluse.py"),
    "rr_staged_new": ("git", "beec1f2f8:docs/changes/W2-141-hook/role_reads.py"),
    "rr_staged_old": ("git", "beec1f2f8~1:docs/changes/W2-141-hook/role_reads.py"),
    "rr_live_at_commit": ("git", "beec1f2f8:.claude/hooks/role_reads.py"),
    "rr_live_disk": ("disk", ".claude/hooks/role_reads.py"),
    "rr_e02d55e40": ("git", "e02d55e40:.claude/hooks/role_reads.py"),
    "rr_e02d55e40_parent": ("git", "e02d55e40~1:.claude/hooks/role_reads.py"),
    "src_reads": ("git", "beec1f2f8:src/gov/guard/reads.py"),
    "readme_new": ("git", "beec1f2f8:docs/changes/W2-141-hook/README.md"),
    "readme_old": ("git", "beec1f2f8~1:docs/changes/W2-141-hook/README.md"),
    "bash_writes_live": ("git", "beec1f2f8:.claude/hooks/bash_writes.py"),
}

DIFFS = [
    ("live_at_commit", "staged_new"),
    ("hook_15952bbfa", "staged_old"),
    ("staged_old", "staged_new"),
    ("hook_2a6462653", "hook_9cce7430d"),
    ("rr_live_at_commit", "rr_staged_new"),
    ("rr_staged_old", "rr_staged_new"),
    ("readme_old", "readme_new"),
]


def main():
    data = {}
    for name, (kind, spec) in SPECS.items():
        try:
            data[name] = blob(spec) if kind == "git" else disk(spec)
        except Exception as exc:  # report and keep going
            print(f"{name:22s} ERROR {spec}: {exc}")
            continue
        print(f"{name:22s} sha256={hashlib.sha256(data[name]).hexdigest()} bytes={len(data[name])} {spec}")
    for a, b in DIFFS:
        if a not in data or b not in data:
            continue
        la = data[a].decode("utf-8").splitlines(keepends=True)
        lb = data[b].decode("utf-8").splitlines(keepends=True)
        diff = list(difflib.unified_diff(la, lb, fromfile=a, tofile=b, n=3))
        path = os.path.join(OUT, f"diff_{a}__{b}.txt")
        with open(path, "w") as f:
            f.writelines(diff)
        changed = sum(1 for line in diff if line[:1] in "+-" and not line.startswith(("+++", "---")))
        print(f"diff {a} -> {b}: {changed} changed lines -> {path}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
